description: The signed-in reader's taste: the books, authors, series, genres and moods they love, what they avoid or quit, why each one counts, and how far from their usual taste they like to range. A recommendation for this reader rests on it, so it suits "what should I read next", "recommend me a book", "something I would like" and "what kind of books do I like" when no book or mood is named. The strongest 40 entries come back by default, and limit raises that. Needs a linked Siftivo account. It is the same profile the app's own recommendations use.

limit.description: Most steering entries to return, strongest first
